cards.name: Start Oval
cards.id: Symbols/Illuminate Flow Charts.ai#Start Oval
cards.summary: Symbol 'Start Oval' from Illustrator's Illuminate Flow Charts symbol library: a wide ellipse in glossy blue with a pale aqua top and a darker blue band across the middle, with a thin lighter outline and a faint offset edge; the flowchart start shape. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 45 x 22 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: start and end points of a flowchart
oval nodes in system and process diagrams
plain glossy badges for a label
avoid: text on its own: the shape holds no label; add one with the Type tool
a flat or print-friendly look: the gloss and gradient are baked in; break the link and set a flat fill for one-colour work
print-size use at natural size: it is only about 45 x 22 pt; scale it up first
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Illuminate Flow Charts; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Start Oval")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Illuminate Flow Charts.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Wide glossy blue ellipse with aqua top and darker middle band, as described.

cards.summary: Symbol 'Elliptical Right Aligned Right 2' from Illustrator's Illuminate Org Charts symbol library: a left-to-right tree of nine glossy navy pills with indigo borders: one at the left, three in the middle and five at the right (three off the top middle pill, two off the bottom one, none off the middle one), joined by thin white right-angle (elbow) lines that end in small bracket caps at each child. The white connectors disappear on a white page. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on a mid-grey checker, where white paint shows white and holes show the checker, applied by script; natural size about 158 x 139 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: sideways hierarchy and breakdown charts on a dark or mid-tone background
org charts that read left to right
avoid: editing the chart in place: it is one grouped symbol with blank nodes; break the link and ungroup to move boxes, add rows or type labels (the connectors are plain lines that do not follow a moved node)
a white or very pale page: the connectors are thin white lines and vanish; place it on a dark ground or recolour the lines after breaking the link
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Illuminate Org Charts; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Elliptical Right Aligned Right 2")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Illuminate Org Charts.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: On the mid-grey checker the nine navy pills (1, 3, 5) and the thin light elbow connectors with bracket caps are all visible, matching the card; the stale white-backing sentence was updated.

previous.note: The gallery thumbnail shows only the nine navy pills because the renderer put this mostly dark artwork on white, where its thin white elbow connectors vanish; the raw transparent export composited on dark grey shows white right-angle lines ending in small bracket caps.

review.changes: summary, look, use_for, avoid and confidence rewritten: the connectors are thin white elbow lines with bracket caps (seen in the raw export on a dark ground), no longer 'inferred, not seen'
